question: The 108 feet bronze statue of prosperity in Bengaluru, inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, has been built to commemorate whom?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nadaprabhu Kempegowda.**__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] Key Points__

__
 
• PM Modi on 11th Nov 2022 unveiled a 108-feet tall bronze statue of Sri Nadaprabhu Kempegowda in Bengaluru.
 
• The ‘Statue of Prosperity’ has been built to commemorate the contribution of Nadaprabhu Kempegowda, the founder of Bengaluru.
 
• It has been conceptualised & sculpted by Ram V Sutar, sculptor of Statue of Unity.
 
• 98 tonnes of bronze & 120 tonnes of steel have gone into making this statue.
